sampling: Four smallest SHA256(prefix + address) values among the 81 candidate sources with at least two inputs in their unique collector payment; fixed before API requests, without replacing failures.
cutoff: Unchanged extractor: only confirmed transactions at heights strictly below each reference-payment block; exclude that entire block and later activity.
evaluation: Descriptive extension only, no training/test split. One incident group, unknown compromise/hardware labels, no legitimate controls. Compare to the existing eight-source pilot without recollecting or altering it.
publication: Prefix-only evidence, feature vectors, collection/selection hashes and aggregate comparison; raw address histories remain local under ignored raw/.
